name: Takada Nozomi
source:
An aloof girl who desires the ground from the roof.

On the surface she seems lighthearted and friendly, but her eyes reflect a hidden despair. The protagonist meets her when he takes a smoke break up on the rooftop.

[Translated from [url=http://craftwork.product.co.jp/CATALOG/adieu/chara/chara_02.html]official profile[/url]]
